description: CDD task handoff contract (implement / review / fix / branch-review). The engine writes or materializes this file; the agent's job is the content of findings[] and the declared work fields below. Write findings, not status — the engine derives status from findings. Each property below documents its rule.

tasks.description: The dispatch group's task numbers (1-indexed; the plan's `### Task N:` ids) — the carrier's single task identity (single-data-model: no separate top-level `task` scalar; `--tasks 1` → [1], `--tasks 1,2` → [1,2]).

phase.description: dispatch phase; determined by the engine, not authored by the agent.

status.description: The round conclusion (this dispatch's terminal result) — APPROVED: done; CHANGES_REQUESTED: fix the findings (terminal conclusion of a review round; the fix loop runs as its own dispatch); REVIEW_FIX: the warn/nit-only review conclusion (收口态 — the review closed and its fix round routes the task to complete without a re-review, #278); BLOCKED: the round cannot proceed — the failure mechanism lives in failure_category, the reason on the stderr `CDD_BLOCKED:` single channel (the stdout blocker column is retired); TIMEOUT: budget or liveness exceeded. Orthogonal surfaces: failure_category (mechanism channel) and unverifiable[]/plan_conflicts[] (content-level notes) never fold into status. The review family (review / branch-review) may omit this field — the engine derives it from findings; implement / fix (work types) must declare it. Write findings, not status.

failure_category.description: Failure mechanism channel — which mechanism ended the round (TIMEOUT / CONTRACT_VIOLATION / ENGINE_SELF_WRITTEN / EXECUTION_FAILURE / UNVERIFIABLE / PLAN_CONFLICT). Orthogonal to status (the round conclusion) and to the content-level unverifiable[]/plan_conflicts[] notes. Engine-written on failure paths; declared by the agent only when it reports one. A BLOCKED round may satisfy its grounding via this field (see allOf).

commits.description: commit identity of the dispatch's review/fix range; the template-contract review range check at 13.5 validates it.

base.description: range base (TASK_BASE / FIXED_POINT): full 40-char SHA; never --short / %h / any truncated form.

head.description: full 40-char SHA; never --short / %h / any truncated form. Optional — omitted when the round has no head yet (e.g. some BLOCKED branch-review payloads).

review_scope.description: review dispatch scope (task vs branch); determined by the dispatch, not authored.

artifacts.description: point at files, do not embed report bodies — values are paths (brief / report / test_evidence), never inline content.

lens.description: review lens label (one of the round's REVIEW_LENS_GUIDE — prevents axis mixing).

severity.description: blocker → CHANGES_REQUESTED; warn/nit → REVIEW_FIX (收口态 — the engine rolls findings up to status, #278).

section.description: section or file the finding anchors to.

file.description: repo-relative file the finding anchors to.

fix.description: what to change to resolve the finding.

task.description: per-task section attribution (grouped review): the task this finding belongs to, one of the group's `tasks`. Absent → the finding is group-level.

findings.description: [{lens, severity, section|file, line?, summary, fix, task?}] — every review finding; severity blocker → CHANGES_REQUESTED, warn/nit → REVIEW_FIX (收口态 — the engine rolls findings up to status, #278); the optional per-task field carries the grouped review's section attribution.

file.description: repo-relative path of a file this round changed.

reason.description: why the file changed (finding id / brief item / fix intent); omitted entries stay attributed by file.

changes.description: Changed-file attribution ledger (implement/fix rounds declare every file the round touched, each with its reason). The engine reconciles `git diff <base>..HEAD` against it — files off the ledger are booking gaps the execution layer only surfaces (stderr CDD_WARN + a notes record, never a block); the review scope axis judges them as findings.

unverifiable.description: Content-level notes — each entry states one claim the round could not verify (what + why: e.g. {claim, why}). A non-empty list makes the round BLOCKED with failure_category UNVERIFIABLE and a blocker summarizing the entries. Dev-measured acceptance items (plan-constraints §口径) are NOT unverifiable: an evidence-contract accepted-noted round records them in `notes`, never writes unverifiable and never blocks.

plan_conflicts.description: Content-level notes — each entry states one plan conflict discovered during the round. A non-empty list makes the round BLOCKED with failure_category PLAN_CONFLICT and a blocker summarizing the entries.

blocker.description: Vacant on the task/branch faces — no longer an agent declaration channel (agents ground BLOCKED via `failure_category`, never this field; the stdout `blocker:` column is retired). Written only by engine failure carriers (writeBlockedCarrier / commit-contract rewrite / exhaustion markers) — real sources only, never fabricated; omit when nothing blocks (NOT null) — null is invalid. BLOCKED requires a non-empty failure_category (see allOf).

notes.description: free-form evidence notes (why this fix / why test-evidence was re-recorded / dev-measured acceptance items recorded per §口径 accepted-noted); optional.

test_evidence.description: reference to command outputs (paths), never inline output bodies.
